text: Cyprus uses both standard **white** European license plates, and UK-style plates that have a **yellow rear plate**. Most license plates have the EU strip on the left. Rental cars, which have a distinct **red** plate, are not uncommon either.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯同時使用標準的**白色**歐洲車牌，以及帶有**黃色後車牌**的英式車牌。大多數車牌左側都有歐盟條帶。帶有獨特**紅色**車牌的租賃車也很常見。

text: Only the southern half of the Island, namely the Republic of Cyprus and the British overseas territories of Akrotiri and Dhekelia are covered.
text_zh: 僅涵蓋該島的南部，即賽普勒斯共和國以及英國海外領地阿克羅提利與德凱利亞。

text: Cyprus uses the Greek and English languages. Greek has a unique alphabet not used in any other language. It shares similarities with both the Latin and [Cyrillic](https://www.plonkit.net/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png) alphabets, however the lower case letters generally have softer shapes than the Cyrillic letters.
NOTE: It goes without saying, but Greece also uses the Greek alphabet.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯使用希臘語和英語。希臘語有一套其他任何語言都沒有的獨特字母。它與拉丁字母和[斯拉夫字母](https://www.plonkit.net/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png)都有相似之處，但小寫字母通常比斯拉夫字母具有更柔和的形狀。
注意：不用說，希臘也使用希臘字母。

text: Cyprus drives on the **left** side of the road.
NOTE: Malta also drives on the left.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯是靠道路**左側**行駛。
注意：馬爾他也是靠左駕駛。

text: A former crown colony of the United Kingdom until 1960, Cyprus continues to use some **borrowed infrastructure**, like signs and roadlines. This is also why Cyprus drives on the **left**, and why** English** is so widely used.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯在 1960 年以前曾是大英帝國的皇家殖民地，至今仍保留了一些**借用自英國的基礎設施**，例如標誌和道路標線。這也是為什麼賽普勒斯是靠**左**駕駛，以及**英文**如此普及的原因。

text: Most coverage on the island was taken with a Generation 4 “smallcam”, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, with a [short antenna sometimes visible](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RLr9WU3DtaeHXx4i7) on the back.
NOTE: Greece also has a significant amount of smallcam coverage, but will never have a visible antenna.
text_zh: 島上的多數街景覆蓋都是使用第 4 相機世代的「smallcam」拍攝，其安裝位置比一般第 4 相機世代更低，並具有相對大的圓形模糊遮罩，前方有一個小突起。這個模糊遮罩有時也可能是完全透明的，並且[後方有時可見短天線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RLr9WU3DtaeHXx4i7)。
注意：希臘也有相當數量的 smallcam 街景覆蓋，但絕不會出現可見的天線。

text: Bollards are superficially similar to Turkish bollards, with a red reflector at the front and a white one at the back. However, unlike Turkish bollards, they are not flat but rather triangular, with a slanted top.
text_zh: 路樁表面上與土耳其路樁相似，前方有一個紅色反光片，後方則是一個白色反光片。然而，與土耳其路樁不同的是，它們不是平的，而是呈三角形，且頂部有傾斜設計。

text: Directional signs are very similar to Greek directional signs, with the one notable difference being that the Greek text is written in **all-caps**.
text_zh: 方向標誌與希臘的方向標誌非常相似，一個明顯的區別是希臘文全部使用**大寫字母**書寫。

text: Town entry signs consist of either a yellow rectangle with a red border, or just the smaller white rectangle that contains the town name in both Greek and English. The signs will also contain a speed limit sign above them. These designs are unique to Cyprus.
text_zh: 城鎮入口標誌是由一個帶有紅邊的黃色長方形，或是僅有較小的白色長方形組成，上面同時以希臘文和英文標示城鎮名稱。這些標誌上方也常有速限標誌。這些設計是賽普勒斯特有的。

text: Utility poles are primarily **wooden**, typically quite **tall** and have a distinctly dark brown colour.
NOTE: All of these features are shared with Greek utility poles.
text_zh: 電線桿主要是**木製**的，通常相當**高**，且具有明顯的深棕色。
注意：所有這些特徵都與希臘的電線桿相同。

text: Poles commonly have one of three poletops. The first consists of a **crossbar** with** zero** or **three insulators** on top. The second consists of [five insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ufHrL368mHZ8aufFA) attached directly to the side of the pole. And the third one consists of a metal frame **shaped vaguely like a harp**.
NOTE: These are also commonly found in Greece. The symmetrical poletop with three insulators is specific to Cyprus.
text_zh: 電線桿通常有三種頂端造型。第一種由一個**橫木**組成，上方有**零個**或**三個絕緣子**。第二種由[五個絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ufHrL368mHZ8aufFA)直接固定在電線桿側面組成。第三種則是由一個**形狀有點像豎琴**的金屬框架組成。
注意：這些在希臘也很常見。具有三個絕緣子的對稱電線桿頂端則是賽普勒斯特有的。

text: Most buildings are made of brightly painted stone, with either a tiled or a flat roof.
NOTE: These features are also common in Greek architecture.
text_zh: 大多數建築物都是用色彩鮮明的石材建造，配有瓦片屋頂或平屋頂。
註：這些建築特色在希臘建築中也很常見。

text: The island has a Mediterranean landscape, with bright exposed rock, olive trees, palm trees, cypress trees, and green coastal farmland. The interior consists of pine forests in the mountains.
text_zh: 這座島嶼擁有地中海景觀，有明亮的裸露岩石、橄欖樹、棕櫚樹、柏樹以及翠綠的沿海農田。內陸山區則是由松樹林組成。

text: Houses in Cyprus often have a** horizontal **and **cylindrical** water tank that is **white **in colour, and has a circular access lid near one end on the top.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯的房屋通常有一個**水平**且**圓柱形**的水塔，顏色是**白色**的，且頂部靠近一端的地方有一個圓形的檢修蓋。

text: Cyprus uses A, B, E, and F roads, and they are grouped by their first digit.
NOTE: E and F roads are located near the B road with the matching first digit. This is useful because B roads are easier to find.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯使用 A、B、E 和 F 級道路，並依其首位數字進行分類。
註：E 級和 F 級道路通常位於首位數字相符的 B 級道路附近。這點很有用，因為 B 級道路比較好找。

text: Each of the 5 provinces uses a two-digit area code,** starting with a 2**.
text_zh: 5 個省份各自使用一個兩位數的區碼，**以 2 開頭**。

text: Cyprus uses four-digit postal codes, grouped by region. They can be [found on street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QLKgfjhF61xNEmVu9), and are denoted by either T.K. or T.T.
The first digits can be useful to memorise.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯使用四位數郵遞區號，依地區分組。這些號碼可以在 [路標上找到](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QLKgfjhF61xNEmVu9)，通常會標示 T.K. 或 T.T.。
記住第一位數字會很有幫助。

text: Being a small island, the terrain will be the easiest way to narrow down your location. Most of the country is hilly to mountainous, with the centre having the highest elevation, that you can use to orient yourself.
text_zh: 作為一個小島，地形會是縮小地區範圍最簡單的方法。全國大部分地區從丘陵到山脈都有，中央地帶海拔最高，你可以利用這一點來辨別方向。

text: While the **bright exposed limestone** rock is a good clue for the country, it is mainly found along its southern coast.
text_zh: 雖然**明亮的裸露石灰岩**岩石是該國的一個好線索，但它主要分佈在南部海岸沿線。

text: On the other hand, **reddish soil** is found in the interior and northwest of the country.
text_zh: 另一方面，**紅色的土壤**則分佈在該國的中部和西北部。

text: **Vineyards **are found more towards the southwest of Cyprus.
text_zh: **葡萄園**更多分佈在賽普勒斯的西南部。

text: **Wild Mustard**, which looks like **bushes of yellow flowers**, while possible to find on most of Cyprus, is most common in these areas, mainly in the eastern half of the country.
text_zh: **野芥菜**看起來像**黃色花叢**，雖然在賽普勒斯大部分地區都能找到，但在這些區域最為常見，主要位於該國的東半部。

text: The Paphos Forest nature reserve consists of windy mountain roads with red soil on the sides, passing through the mostly uninhabited Mediterranean forest. You will not see any bollards in the reserve, with few exceptions.
text_zh: 帕福斯森林（Paphos Forest）自然保護區由多風的山路組成，兩側帶有紅土，穿過幾乎無人居住的地中海森林。在此保護區內除了少數例外，你看不到任何路樁。

text: In the northeast of Cyprus, you will often be able to see the** Kyrenia Mountain ridge** to the **north**, overlooking the otherwise flat farmland.
text_zh: 在賽普勒斯東北部，你通常可以看到**吉里山脈（Kyrenia Mountain ridge）**位於**北方**，俯瞰著其他方面較為平坦的農田。

text: **Dark red fields**, even if covered in vegetation, are a good clue for northern Cyprus and Famagusta, the far eastern region.
text_zh: **深紅色農田**，即使被植被覆蓋，也是判斷賽普勒斯北部以及最東邊區域法馬古斯塔（Famagusta）的好線索。

text: Famagusta can easily be recognised by the mostly flat landscape, with lots of red fields. Maybe more importantly though, all of the coverage is **shitcam**.
NOTE: Shitcam is quite rare in the rest of Cyprus.
text_zh: 法馬古斯塔可以透過大致平坦的地貌以及大量紅色田地輕易辨認。不過可能更重要的是，所有的街景覆蓋都是**爛畫質相機**。
注意：Shitcam 在賽普勒斯其他地區相當罕見。

text: **Wind turbines** are found in two main clusters on Cyprus: west of Larnaca in the east, and southwest of Anogyra, near the Limassol-Paphos subdivision border.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯的**風力發電機**主要分布在兩個群落：東部的拉納卡（Larnaca）西方，以及靠近利馬索爾-帕福斯（Limassol-Paphos）行政區交界處、阿諾吉拉（Anogyra）西南方。

text: The wind turbines in the east are built on **sandy rolling hills**, surrounded by **agricultural fields** .
text_zh: 東部的風力發電機建在**沙質起伏丘陵**上，周圍環繞著**農田**。

text: The wind turbines in the SW are located within the Oreites Forest, a shrubby hill surrounded by more extreme elevation. There is a noticeable incline towards the coast, which is often visible to the southwest.
text_zh: 西南方的風力發電機位於奧賴特斯森林（Oreites Forest）內，這是一座灌木叢生的山丘，周圍有著更極端的高低起伏。往海岸方向有明顯的坡度，從西南方通常看得見。

text: A different kind of **bollard with a black top**, resembling those found in Slovenia for example, can sometimes be found in north-eastern Cyprus.
NOTE: The presence of regular Cypriot bollards does not exclude the highlighted region.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯東北部有時可以找到另一種**帶有黑色頂部的路樁**，例如斯洛維尼亞也能找到類似的款式。
注意：出現常規的賽普勒斯路樁並不排除所突顯的區域。

text: **Snow coverage** can be found on a few roads southeast of the Cyprus island label, near the Holy Monastery of Panagia Machaira.
text_zh: 在賽普勒斯島標籤東南方、帕納吉亞馬海拉修道院（Holy Monastery of Panagia Machaira）附近的一些道路上，可以找到**雪景覆蓋**。

text: **Dashed blue lines** between the outer and inner road markings can be seen on a few roads around Mount Olympus.
text_zh: 奧林帕斯山（Mount Olympus）周圍的一些道路上，可以看到外側和內側道路標線之間有**藍色虛線**。

text: **Banana plantations** can be found along the western coast around Peyia.
text_zh: 在佩亞（Peyia）周圍的西部海岸可以找到**香蕉園**。

text: With a Russian-speaking population of around 17%, many commercial signs in Limassol feature **Russian **translations.
text_zh: 由於擁有約 17% 的俄語人口，利馬索爾（Limassol）的許多商業招牌都有**俄語**翻譯。
